run_stable_diffusion_3_inpaint_pipeline: run the StableDiffusion3InpaintPipeline to generate inpainted images from a prompt, source image, and mask
encode_stable_diffusion_3_prompt: encode text prompts using CLIP and T5 text encoders into prompt embeddings for the StableDiffusion3InpaintPipeline
prepare_inpaint_mask_latents: prepare mask and masked image latents for inpainting by resizing, encoding, and duplicating for classifier-free guidance
prepare_inpaint_latents: prepare initial latents for inpainting by encoding the source image and mixing with noise based on strength parameter
calculate_scheduler_shift: calculate the dynamic shifting mu value for the FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler based on image sequence length
